editorial.blurb: Taqueria El Milagro serves authentic Mexican fare that tastes like home cooking, with standout dishes like pork in green salsa and carne asada that keep locals and travelers coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive at lunch on a weekday for minimal wait; order at the counter and grab a table—your number will be called when ready. Skip the rice and load up on the tamales and protein-forward dishes instead.
